ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to a human safety reviewer: preserve the in-app chat and GPS record for T-2044, contact the rider with the SAFE-2 reporting routes (995 if medical help is needed, driver's commercial motor insurance for claims, RydeHELP for the report), and review the driver's conduct under the Code of Conduct. Do not auto-execute any refund of the $32.86 RydeX fare on this record.
ruling.reasoning: This is a safety-type dispute, so the safety screen governs and no automatic ruling is issued. The rider's complaint ("threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out") is corroborated by the in-app chat — 17:09:35 rider: "Please stop the car, I want to get out here."; 17:10:30 driver: "Sit down or I lock the doors." That message is the driver aiming a threat/intimidation at the rider, which Ryde's Code of Conduct bars ("Threats and Intimidation … abuse of any kind will not be tolerated"). The driver's own statement admits he refused to stop and "drove on" after the rider asked to exit, which is also a dangerous/unsafe-conduct allegation (rider felt unsafe for the whole ride). Both prongs fall under SAFE-1 (threat/intimidation in chat) and SAFE-2 (safety incident), so the case goes to a human reviewer rather than an automated decision. No fare arithmetic is performed: the fare is a fixed RydeX quote of $32.86 (base 3.90 + distance 21.82 + time 5.67 + platform 1.47) and no cancellation or waiting fee was charged, so there is nothing to refund automatically. The GPS trace (17:02:20–17:31:40) shows the car did not stop and continued to Bedok Mall, so the rider's account of being kept in the moving vehicle is consistent with the record. Safety_concern is "confirmed" on the chat text itself; escalation reason is the safety screen. Nothing in the record is a threat from the rider, and no consent/detour analysis is needed because the dispute is not a route-deviation case.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety-type dispute with a threat/intimidation in the in-app chat (driver: "Sit down or I lock the doors.") and a rider-report of being kept in the car against her request to exit; SAFE-1/SAFE-2 require human review instead of an automated ruling, with 995 / commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths noted.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's account that he only told the rider to sit down "for her own safety" is contradicted by the chat text, which is an explicit threat to lock the doors, and by the rider's request to be let out; system records (chat/GPS) override the statement.
